evals.prompt: Write a short manual test runbook for the theme preset picker. Save it to docs/runbooks/theme-preset-picker.md. Keep it under 30 lines and include a Web section and an Expo Go section. Do not write any test code.
evals.expected_output: A concise runbook file at docs/runbooks/theme-preset-picker.md with Web and Expo Go sections, no test files created.

expectations.name: has_expo_go_section
expectations.description: Runbook contains an 'Expo Go' or 'mobile' section

evals.prompt: The debug overlay tab no longer crashes. Before we add regression tests, what is the very first step of our testing workflow? Reply in one sentence and cite the workflow phase name.
evals.expected_output: Agent answers that the first step is Phase 1 EXPLORE (manual exploration), not writing tests.

expectations.name: answers_explore_first
expectations.description: Response contains 'explore' or 'EXPLORE' and does not say to write tests first

expectations.name: no_test_code_first
expectations.description: Response does not say the first step is to write Playwright/automated tests

evals.prompt: During runbook verification on iOS, the simulator fails to launch. According to our testing workflow, what is the next step? Reply with a numbered list of exactly 3 actions.
evals.expected_output: Agent lists: stop verification, fix the blocker, restart verification on both platforms. No automated tests yet.

expectations.name: stop_and_fix
expectations.description: Response says to stop, fix, or document the failure before continuing

expectations.name: restart_verification
expectations.description: Response says to restart or re-run verification on both platforms after fixing

expectations.name: no_automation_yet
expectations.description: Response does not say to proceed to automated tests
